name: Hide Armor
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: One suit of armor and one Shield at a time. Without armor training: Disadvantage on Strength/Dexterity D20 Tests and no spellcasting. A listed Strength requirement reduces Speed by 10 feet unless met; listed Stealth Disadvantage applies while worn.

authored_operations: One suit of armor and one Shield at a time. Without armor training: Disadvantage on Strength/Dexterity D20 Tests and no spellcasting. A listed Strength requirement reduces Speed by 10 feet unless met; listed Stealth Disadvantage applies while worn.

definition.name: Hide Armor
definition.description: This crude armor consists of thick furs and pelts. It is commonly worn by barbarian tribes, evil humanoids, and other folk who lack access to the tools and materials needed to create better armor.
